README.md: Edit layout.json to rearrange this workspace’s activity. Keep each named section once. To group sections, replace them in the list with {"display": "stack", "title": "Update", "sections": ["headline", "details"]}. Use columns for a side-by-side group on wide screens. Set postsPerPage in client.js to show between 1 and 50 updates. Publish the revision to update this workspace. In server.js, env.TEDIX.connectionsCall can call tools granted through a bound connection.
